Medieval Village MegaKit

A downloadable asset pack

Download NowName your own price

The Medieval Village MEGAKIT is a pack containing more than 300 modular environment pieces, designed to fit perfectly in a grid, with walls that include both an exterior and an interior at the same time, modular roofs, stairs and much more, letting you create your own village with thousands of different possible combinations. The modular system is very flexible and easy to use.

Features:

  • 300+ Unique models in a wide variety of categories (walls, floors, stairs, roofs, etc)
  • Source version comes with all 300+ assets already implemented in Unity (URP), Unreal and Godot with custom shaders enabling customizable wear colors and letting you start creating without any setup!
  • Source version also has custom optimized collisions for each model.
  • Free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects. (CC0 License)
  • .FBX, .OBJ and .glTF formats, compatible with all engines.
